summary: HALT1 V2 halt observability, third head, reviewed from scratch. Scope verified by diff not by the PR text: schwab_v2_rest_client.py +13/-0, schwab_1m_v2_bot.py +124/-1, test_schwab_1m_v2_bot.py +249/-0. Base is current origin/main; 3 commits, each exactly one OpenAI Codex marker; reviewer differs from every author. WHAT IT DOES: feeds Schwab tradeTime and quoteTime into the existing shared LiveHaltTracker and publishes halted_symbols/reasons/since plus a halt_monitor MEASURED-or-UNEXERCISED block through the V2 data_health payload. POPULATION, checked before measuring: Quote is constructed in exactly ONE production site (schwab_v2_rest_client.py:380) and on_quote is wired REST-only (bot :572) - the streamer carries bars and ticks, never quotes - so the parse change reaches 100 percent of the quotes that reach _handle_quote, with no second path that would silently leave trade_time_ms at 0. MY TWO EARLIER BLOCKERS, both re-derived on this head rather than accepted. B1: a non-numeric tradeTime used to drop the whole quote (base 1 quote, old head 0 quotes); the trade timestamp is now parsed in its own try/except OUTSIDE the Quote construction, and my probes deliver the quote for a non-numeric ISO string, float inf, 10**30, negative and absent. B2: an out-of-unit numeric tradeTime used to raise out of _handle_quote into the unguarded await self._on_quote at rest_client:235, aborting the poll pass; the conversion is now bounded and the observer call is wrapped, and the strategy received the quote in every probe. F1, THE THIRD-ROUND BLOCKER, IS THE ONE THAT MATTERED MOST AND IT IS FIXED. The previous bound was 0 < ms < 2100 which admitted every small positive value, so a seconds-valued tradeTime converted cleanly to 1970 and produced a PERMANENT false CONFIRMED halt that flipped the operator health card healthy->degraded and flapped CONFIRMED/RECOVERED per quote. The floor is now 1_577_836_800_000 (2020-01-01) inclusive. I re-probed all ten boundaries myself: seconds-valued, 1, 0, negative, floor-1, floor exactly, ceil-1, ceil exactly, nanoseconds and a current-era value - every one correct. Behaviourally, three seconds-valued quotes now yield halted_symbols=[] with status healthy and halt_monitor UNEXERCISED/denominator 0, and all 3 quotes still reached the strategy. THAT IS THE PROPERTY I MOST WANTED: it degrades to UNEXERCISED, never to a false clean and never to a false halt. AND THE TEST IS NOW DISCRIMINATING, which was the actual defect last round. The old test_halt_observer_rejects_out_of_range_timestamp_without_raising was satisfied by the inner except (OSError, OverflowError, ValueError) rather than by the bound, so deleting the bound left the file 43/43 GREEN - a check that could not come out false. It was REPLACED, not supplemented, by test_halt_observer_rejects_seconds_valued_timestamp_by_plausibility_bound, and relaxing the floor back to 0 now turns that test RED. Nanosecond coverage is not lost: test_out_of_range_halt_timestamp_never_suppresses_strategy_quote still feeds 1.78e18 and asserts both quote delivery and denominator 0. SIX MUTATIONS, each RED, each restored with a landing probe, tree confirmed clean and 43/43 after: (1) relax the floor to 0 -> seconds-valued test RED; (2) remove the bound entirely -> RED; (3) revert the rest-client tradeTime guard -> 2 RED; (4) remove the observer try/except -> observer-failure test RED; (5) turn the observer INTO a decision gate -> no-gate control RED; (6) disable the two subscription-prune filters -> prune test RED. Mutation (5) is the one that carries the whole observability-only claim and it is enforced by a test, not asserted in prose. I also verified the hasattr guard by mutation on the previous head: removing it turns test_bar_feed_survives_delisting_so_the_flip_exit_can_arm and test_broker_flat_but_internally_held_stays_covered RED, so codex-2's answer that two lightweight coverage harnesses call _push_desired_symbols without the full constructor is proven, not taken on trust. F2 IS WITHDRAWN AND THE ERROR WAS MINE. I reported the no-gate control as intermittently RED in the full suite. It was not a flake: I launched that full-suite run from the same worktree I then applied the gate mutation to, so the running suite imported the mutated module. This review ran the suites from a pristine worktree and mutations from a separate one. codex-2 identified the cause correctly and its extra isolation of the control was work my artefact caused. CONTROLLED PAIR, one variable, same command pytest tests -q -p no:randomly on the same machine, from worktrees nothing touched during the run: base a0e74c98 46 failed / 3306 passed / 12 errors; head 01b64ddd 46 failed / 3316 passed / 12 errors; +10 is exactly the ten tests this PR adds; failure sets AND error sets extracted and diffed BY NAME and IDENTICAL. codex-2 reported 55/3297 -> 55/3307, the same +10 with the known platform gap recorded on the #898/#902/#907/#911 pins. NOT COVERED, and none of it blocks: (a) warning_symbols is STILL hardcoded [] at bot:400 and nothing writes it while control_plane:1892 reads it, so HALT1's always-empty-field defect is only HALF closed - do not close the row as fixed; (b) the detector cannot distinguish a venue HALT from ILLIQUIDITY - halt_is_confirmed is only a >=285s print gap plus >=2 quote updates with NO session guard, and V2 polls across the whole 07:00-16:00 window, so a thin symbol that prints once and goes quiet will read halted; paper_exit.py uses the identical unguarded definition so V2 is consistent with the established consumer, but no decision gate may EVER be built on this field without a separately reviewed session-aware design; (c) it reaches the dashboard and PAGES NOBODY - _sync_runtime_data_health_incidents iterates only StrategyBotRuntime entries, which the isolated V2 bot is not, and further filters on a 'Completed bar flow stalled:' prefix the new reason does not match; (d) UNEXERCISED in production - no live V2 halt has been observed by this code.
